subfamily: Collins: the Tom Collins (Cocktail Codex p. 138) with its simple syrup swapped for Indian cane-jaggery syrup
glass: tall (Collins) glass, chilled, filled with ice
_status: v4 (Tomás, round 5) = v2 restored with a sourced sugar figure. v3 (Indian-rum daiquiri) withdrawn: the reading and anchors are built on her one swap, the sugar; Oxford pdf 1946's 'pair best with dark spirits' is a preference, and the Matrix (pdf 240) pairs cane syrup with grain and orange. Codex p. 138: 60 seltzer / 60 gin / 30 lemon / 22.5 simple / orange half wheel + brandied cherry. Here: syrup 25 ml (jaggery less sweet), seltzer 50, orange peel: so never 'only one change'. Sweep: gin 40/43/47% x jaggery 47/52/58 g (Hirpara F19 via Hester) x syrup 22.5/25 x soda 45/50. Chosen 25/50 with gin 43%+: balanced throughout, sugar edge from about 57 g (7.60; 7.73 at 58), per Hester's re-run, round 6; 40% gin edges strength 12.4. Soda 45 OUT at 58 g. contains nuts (groundnut clarifier, F20) and dairy (milk clarifier, unsourced, kept on the safe side): NOT veto-free.
